scale_points.name: ew_structural_shell_bare
scale_points.note: bare ladder at structural EW shell m=5 (pre-brace)

scale_points.name: ew_brace_W
scale_points.note: Gauss->EW double-axis brace; W / alpha(M_Z) analogue

w_to_thomson.note: W (EW brace ~129) and Thomson (~137) are two evaluations of one monotone ladder; the IR shells between them are the (unproved) running segment

observable_policies.rationale: closed mass dominated by nuclear cluster + Z*m_e + proton lock-in; raw alpha decouples
inside/outside curvature network uses lattice alpha=3/5, not fine-structure alpha
network weights and freezeout use lattice/curvature couplings
exp(n*alpha/6) APS spurion needs EW-scale alpha (the W value ~129)
anomalous moment spurion uses global brace alpha at sector scale
Rydberg / fine structure / Lamb shift live at q^2 -> 0; need alpha(0) ~= 1/137
precise ionization energies need Thomson-scale alpha, not structural shell
H 1s binding uses alpha(0); structural shell m=1 (1/alpha~83) overbinds ~2.76x

status_note: Endpoints reproduced (W brace ~129, Thomson ~137 near ladder m~20). The running curve between them is a phenomenological bridge on the bare O-Maxwell ladder, NOT yet a proved RG theorem. Most HQIV observables do not need raw alpha; spectroscopy-class observables use the IR/Thomson value.
